experiment: TSP-R Phase 1: replication of the truth-subspace-preserving fine-tune (TSP) with cross-fitted cities, 8 base seeds, label-shuffled and random controls
status: FROZEN before any Phase 1 training (approved in principle by the user; launch needs explicit approval)
research_question: Does penalising reconstruction error inside a truth subspace S (rank 8, estimated on GoT A rows) reduce the loss of linearly and nonlinearly decodable truth information in GPT-2 Small L8 TopK SAE reconstructions, relative to the identical fine-tune without the penalty, specifically because S is truth-aligned, at no meaningful reconstruction or behavioural cost?

design.model: GPT-2 Small (frozen), blocks.8.hook_resid_pre, final token; BOS excluded

base_saes.architecture: R2 TopK, width 12288, k=128, modern_v1, 99,999,744 OWT tokens (shard 78)
base_saes.new_base_recipe: scripts/openwebtext/17_streaming_sae_training.py train(), layer 8, topk only, SEEDS patched, written to results/openwebtext/r2_tspr_base_seeds/ (staging, then renamed)
base_saes.base_qc: final monitor EV within +-0.005 of the original 3 seeds range [0.90525, 0.90531], L0 = 128, dead <= 0.01, GPT-2 unchanged; failure stops the experiment

arms.tsp: ctrl + 1.0 * subspace loss in S_f (truth subspace of fold A rows; pilot estimator)
arms.rand: same term, Haar-random rank-8 subspace (seed per fold)
arms.pca: same term, top-8 PCA subspace of fold A rows (label-free; secondary)
arms.shuf: same term, S from the identical estimator on fold A rows with truth labels permuted within each (city, polarity) cell

design.fine_tune_recipe: scripts/geometry_of_truth/25_truth_subspace_finetune.py run_one, unchanged: Adam 2e-5, clip 1, decoder renormalised, 1,230 steps x 32 x 127 OWT tokens (shard 79 chunks >= 10,000; identical tokens for every run), torch seed = base seed, mu = lambda = 1, rank 8

folds.roles: fold f: V = f (evaluation), B = f+1 (probe fitting), A = f+2 (S, GoT replay)
folds.excluded: the 113 exposed cities TEST groups are never loaded

design.matrix: 8 seeds x 5 arms x 3 folds = 120 fine-tunes (plan_matrix.csv); references: 8 base SAEs evaluated in each fold (24 evaluations)

subspace_diagnostics_at_freeze.note: mean squared principal-angle cosine; chance 0.0104. Only the leading truth direction is stable across folds; an independent B-fold probe direction has 50-55 % of its norm^2 in S_tsp, 8 % in S_shuf, 1.5 % in S_rand, ~0 in S_pca

primary.dataset: cities + neg_cities, cross-fitted (sole confirmatory dataset; D41)
primary.metric: re-fit logistic gap = AUROC_V(probe fitted on original B_f activations) - AUROC_V(probe fitted on x_hat(B_f)), each probe StandardScaler + logistic, C chosen by GroupKFold(3) over cities on B_f from {0.01, 0.1, 1}; scored on V_f. Lower is better (0 = no information loss).
primary.estimand: Delta(tsp - ctrl) = mean over 8 seeds of the fold-weighted (by V groups) mean over 3 folds of the paired per-(seed, fold) gap difference

hypothesis_family_and_multiplicity.H1 (gate): Delta(tsp - ctrl) < 0; two-sided test at alpha 0.05, rejection counted only if the estimate is negative
hypothesis_family_and_multiplicity.procedure: fixed-sequence gatekeeping: H2 and H3 are tested only if H1 is rejected, then Holm over {H2, H3} at alpha 0.05. Family-wise error <= 0.05 over {H1, H2, H3}. pca is secondary and outside the family.

uncertainty.seed: se_seed = sd over 8 seeds of the per-seed fold-pooled difference / sqrt(8)
uncertainty.statement: v_stmt = variance over 2,000 city-group bootstrap resamples (stratified by fold, identical indices for every SAE, arm and seed) of the seed-averaged difference
uncertainty.combined: se = sqrt(se_seed^2 + v_stmt); df = Satterthwaite se^4 / (se_seed^4 / 7) (statement component treated as known); 95 % CI = estimate +- t(df, 0.975) se
sensitivity (reported, not decisive): two-way bootstrap over seeds and city groups (4,000, percentile CI)
pilot rule: t(7) on the combined se
523 previously train-only cities (excludes the 112 pilot validation cities)

qualifiers.not truth-specific: H1 rejected, H2 and H3 not
qualifiers.linear and nonlinear: 10 x 64 MLP re-fit gap Delta(tsp - ctrl) 95 % CI upper < 0 (same uncertainty model)
qualifiers.READOUT-ONLY: H1 not rejected but the frozen logistic gap Delta(tsp - ctrl) CI upper < 0
qualifiers.DISTORTION: enhancement guard: tsp absolute re-fit gap 95 % CI entirely below -0.010 (x_hat more separable than x); replaces preservation wording

cost_guards_non_inferiority_vs_ctrl.rule: one-sided 95 % upper confidence bound of (tsp - ctrl), same seed + resample uncertainty model (OWT: sequence bootstrap of the validation cache)
cost_guards_non_inferiority_vs_ctrl.L0: = 128 exactly on OWT, GoT and RepE
cost_guards_non_inferiority_vs_ctrl.failure: qualifier TRADE-OFF; absolute costs vs R2 base reported for every arm

secondary.companies_true_false (TEST, locked): re-fit logistic gap: probes fitted on DEV (original or x_hat; C by GroupKFold(3) over companies), scored on TEST. Delta(tsp - ctrl) with seed + company-bootstrap uncertainty. Estimate with 95 % CI; conservative MDE ~0.033 stated; never confirmatory.
secondary.common_claim_true_false (TEST, locked): distortion check: DISTORTION flag if tsp - ctrl re-fit gap CI upper < -0.010 or tsp absolute gap CI upper < -0.010; base headroom ~0.001
secondary.MLP readers: 10 x 64 and 5 x 256 MLP re-fit gaps (cities); frozen logistic and mass-mean gaps labelled readout metrics; pca comparisons
secondary.exploratory: counterfact_true_false held-out relations (TEST), fixed C = 0.1 to bound runtime; label EXPLORATORY

data_access.cities: train+val groups only (cities TEST never loaded)
data_access.fresh TEST: activations computed once, in the final evaluation stage, after the P1 analysis is complete and committed; never used for tuning, selection or stopping
data_access.tuning: none after freeze; all hyperparameters are the pilot values

stopping_rules: repro check: any non-zero weight difference vs pilot ctrl seed 42 stops everything
execution_order: base (5 new seeds jointly; ~0.75-1.25 h) then base_qc
freeze evaluation code (second commit with its hash) before any Phase 1 SAE is evaluated
P1 cities evaluation + ladder fold 0 + OWT NMSE all

recovery.session: tmux tspr-phase1; logs in replication_logs/ (gitignored, line-buffered)
recovery.finetune: atomic saves (.pt.tmp then rename); run_ledger.csv with SHA-256 per run; rerunning the same command skips verified runs; a checkpoint without ledger entry or a hash mismatch stops for manual review; nothing is overwritten
recovery.base: staging folder renamed only on success; after an interruption the staging folder is moved aside (not deleted) and the stage rerun from scratch (deterministic seeds)
